article:
For each question, write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.

[--- Table Start ---]
| Review: the Maple Cafe Last week, my friends and I visited the Maple Café which opened recently. Cafés are places teenagers like to visit, and that is (27) …………… I decided to write a review about it! The café is in a nice location, next to the river. It is in a building that (28) …………… to be a bike shop, and the new owners put some old bikes on the walls, which is really unusual!  There is plenty of space inside, or (29) …………… you prefer, there are tables outside, too. When we visited, there was a special offer to celebrate the café opening. We (30) …………… given a free slice of chocolate cake and we all agreed that the Maple Café chocolate cake was better than anything we (31) …………… ever tried before! There are the normal hot and cold drinks you would expect to see, and (32) …………… prices are good. I would certainly recommend that everyone visits! |
[--- Table End ---]

explanations.27:
原因：表语从句 “that's why...” 表 “那就是为什么……”，解释写评论的原因。
语法点：why 引导表语从句，如 That's why I like it.
explanations.28:
原因：“used to be” 表 “过去是”，指建筑过去是自行车店。
词汇点：used to do sth.，如 He used to live here.
explanations.29:
原因：条件句引导词，“如果你更喜欢，也有户外桌子”。
语法点：if 引导条件句，如 If you prefer coffee, I can make it.
explanations.30:
原因：一般过去时被动语态，“我们被赠送免费蛋糕”。
语法点：were done，如 We were given gifts.
explanations.31:
原因：过去完成时 “had ever tried”，“曾试过的最好吃的”，表 “过去的过去”。
语法点：had done，如 She had eaten before I came.
explanations.32:
原因：特指 “咖啡馆的价格”，用定冠词 the。
语法点：the 表特指，如 the book on the table.
